name: CronexAC
summary: This EA trades based on the CronexAC (Accelerator Oscillator) indicator, generating buy and sell signals from AO and AC indicator crossovers and color changes. It opens positions when momentum acceleration confirms trend direction and closes them on signal reversal. The strategy is a systematic momentum-based approach relying on Bill Williams' Accelerator/Decelerator oscillator principles.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CronexAC（加速振荡器）指标进行交易，通过AO和AC指标的交叉及颜色变化生成买卖信号。当动量加速确认趋势方向时开仓，在信号反转时平仓。该策略是一个系统化的动量方法，基于比尔·威廉姆斯的加速/减速振荡器原理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯的加速/减速（AC）振荡器，结合Cronex改进版本的信号平滑处理。入场条件为：做多时AC指标由红转绿（连续两根绿柱）且AO指标为正，做空时AC由绿转红（连续两根红柱）且AO指标为负。出场条件包括：反向信号出现时平仓、止损/止盈触发、或AC指标连续多根反向柱线确认趋势衰竭。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算，默认参数允许用户自定义手数大小。资金管理方面，EA提供止损和止盈参数设置，但默认止损可能较宽，存在一定回撤风险。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于动量确认型交易系统，适合趋势明显的市场环境。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bill Williams' Accelerator/Decelerator (AC) oscillator, combined with Cronex's improved version for signal smoothing. Entry conditions: go long when AC indicator changes from red to green (two consecutive green bars) and AO is positive; go short when AC changes from green to red (two consecutive red bars) and AO is negative. Exit conditions include: closing on reverse signal appearance, stop-loss/take-profit triggers, or AC showing multiple consecutive opposite-color bars confirming trend exhaustion. Position sizing uses fixed lot size or percentage-based calculation of account balance, with default parameters allowing user-customized lot sizes. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameter settings, but default stop-loss may be wide, presenting some drawdown risk. The overall strategy logic is clear, belonging to the momentum confirmation trading system, suitable for markets with clear trending conditions.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示不使用

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 指标计算时间周期，0为当前周期

pros: 策略逻辑基于成熟的比尔·威廉姆斯AC振荡器理论，有较好的理论基础
信号确认机制要求连续同色柱线，减少了虚假信号
参数设计灵活，允许用户自定义止损止盈和手数管理
系统化执行消除情绪干扰，严格按信号交易
Cronex改进版信号平滑处理减少噪声交易
pros_en: Strategy logic based on well-established Bill Williams AC oscillator theory with solid theoretical foundation
Signal confirmation requiring consecutive same-color bars reduces false signals
Flexible parameter design allows user-customized stop-loss, take-profit, and lot management
Systematic execution eliminates emotional interference, strictly following signals
Cronex improved version with signal smoothing reduces noisy trades
cons: 动量振荡器在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
默认止损为0，如果不手动设置则完全没有风险保护
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能同一根K线上重复开仓
没有点差过滤，在高位差环境下可能不利
策略仅依赖单一指标体系，缺乏多维度确认
cons_en: Momentum oscillators easily generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
Default stop-loss of 0 means no risk protection at all if not manually configured
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
No spread filter, which can be detrimental in high-spread environments
Strategy relies solely on a single indicator system, lacking multi-dimensional confirmation
improvements: 增加新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线上重复开仓
添加点差过滤和震荡市识别模块，减少不利市场条件下的交易
实现基于ATR的动态止损止盈，替代固定点数设置
增加多时间框架确认，提高信号可靠性
加入资金管理模块，支持基于风险百分比的动态仓位计算
improvements_en: Add new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated position opening on the same bar
Add spread filter and ranging market identification module to reduce trades in unfavorable conditions
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit instead of fixed pip settings
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability
Incorporate money management module supporting dynamic position sizing based on risk percentage

risk_points: 默认止损为0，存在无限亏损风险
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同K线重复开仓放大风险
动量策略在震荡市中会产生连续亏损
没有点差过滤在高波动时点差扩大可能造成滑点损失
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss of 0 poses unlimited loss risk
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position opening on same bar amplifying risk
Momentum strategy can produce consecutive losses in ranging markets
No spread filter may cause slippage losses when spreads widen during high volatility
